import sys

def calculate(n):
    if n == 0:
        return 0
    baseNumber = 1
    countSteps = 1
    while baseNumber * 10 + 1 < n:
        baseNumber = baseNumber * 10 + 1
        countSteps += 1
    optionA = calculate(n % baseNumber) + (n // baseNumber) * countSteps
    optionB = calculate(((baseNumber * 10 + 1) - n) % baseNumber) + countSteps + 1 + (((baseNumber * 10 + 1) - n) // baseNumber) * countSteps
    return min(optionA, optionB)

def main():
    val = int(sys.stdin.read().strip())
    print(calculate(val))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
